caption: The drawing depicts a woven textile featuring alternating horizontal bands of dark blue, red, and yellow, with intricate white patterns and motifs. The patterns include stylized flowers, leaves, geometric snow-flake or star shapes, and birds perched on branched flowers. In the lower left corner, there is a rectangular section with text in white on blue, red, and yellow backgrounds, reading "S. FLECHER / ONT / OHIO / 1849 / EXCHANGE / UTICA," arranged within defined bordered boxes. The textile has fringes on the left and bottom edges, colored to match the bands they extend from (dark blue, red, or yellow). The background is a plain, light beige or off-white that contrasts with the vibrant colors of the textile. There is a black horizontal band at the bottom, and the edges of the textile show the loose threads and unfinished look of the woven material.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
